{{Quote|Let's go. Try to escape and you'll end up just like him.|Guri, to the Nimbanel|<ref name="bounty">{{WEGCite|story=Bounty's Due|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
A '''Nimbanel''' had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on its head by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] captured the Nimbanel in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] but then tried to ransom more money out of [[Gender/Legends|his]] contractor than initially agreed upon, claiming that capturing the Nimbanel had required more of his resources than usual. Black Sun [[Underlord]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] responded by dispatching his personal [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Guri]], to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Boushh and bring in the Nimbanel herself.
